course.notes_sr: Za svaku lekciju imaš ručno izvučen rečnik (English ↔ srpski), ključne fraze i gramatičke primere iz prvog zadatka i Real World/Help with Grammar boksova, uz srpski rezime i prioritete učenja. questions.q: Šta je nacionalnost za nekoga iz Brazila?
questions.explain: Brazil → Brazilian (sufiks -ian).

questions.q: Šta je nacionalnost za nekoga iz Italije?
questions.explain: Italy → Italian (sufiks -ian).
an + samoglasnički zvuk: an engineer.
Iako počinje slovom u, izgovara se /juː/ (suglasnički zvuk) → a university.
child → children (nepravilna množina).
person → people (nepravilna množina).
name je 3. lice jednine → is. Skraćeno: What's your name?

questions.q: Koji je prevod 'Where are you from?'
questions.explain: Where are you from? = Odakle si?

questions.q: Pristojno tražiš da ti neko ponovi broj telefona. Šta kažeš?
options: Could you say that again, please?
questions.explain: Could you say that again, please? je standardna pristojna fraza.

questions.q: Pokazuješ na više stvari pored sebe. Koju reč koristiš?
questions.explain: these = ovi/ove (množina, blizu); this = ovaj (jednina, blizu).
cheap (jeftin) ↔ expensive (skup).
early (rano) ↔ late (kasno).
I/you/we/they + have got. He/she/it + has got.
3. lice jednine: She has got = She's got.
uncle = stric/ujak/tetak.
grandmother = baka.
half past seven = pola osam (7:30).
8:45 = quarter to nine ili eight forty-five.
Posesivni 's: Tom's = Tomov.

questions.q: Mačka je IZA stolice. Engleska prepozicija je …
questions.explain: behind = iza. In front of = ispred.
have breakfast = doručkovati. Slično: have lunch/dinner.

questions.q: Popuni Wh- pitanje: '___ time do you get up?'
questions.explain: What time = u koliko sati. Pravilo: What time + do + subjekat + glagol.
Negacija u Present Simple za I/you/we/they: don't + bazni glagol.
Yes/No pitanje za you u Present Simple: Do you …?
Redosled: May, June, July, August.

questions.q: Kako pišeš datum '5. mart' na engleskom (BrE)?
questions.explain: the + redni broj + of + mesec: the fifth of March.
never = nikad (0%); always = uvek (100%).
Posle glagola be: She is always late.
they → them. Phone them. / I see them.
on + dani u nedelji: on Monday, on Saturday evening.
3. lice jednine: dodaje se -s. He plays.
Glagoli na -ch dobijaju -es: watch → watches.
Negacija za he/she/it: doesn't + bazni glagol (bez -s).

questions.q: Pitanje: '___ she watch TV a lot?'
questions.explain: Does + subjekat + bazni glagol. Yes, she does.
love/like/hate/enjoy + verb-ing: I love cooking.
fruit = voće (i singular i koristi se kao kolektivno).
sparkling water = gazirana voda; still water = negazirana.

questions.q: Konobar pita: 'Would you like to order now?' — kako pristojno odgovaraš ako želiš?
questions.explain: Yes, please. / No, thanks. — pristojni kratki odgovori.
milk = nebrojivo. Kažemo 'some milk', 'a glass of milk'.
some + množina ili nebrojivo: some eggs, some bread.
I/he/she/it + was. You/we/they + were.
they → were (Past Simple od be).
go → went (nepravilan glagol).
have → had (nepravilan).
Glagol na -y posle suglasnika: y → ied (study → studied).
get married = venčati se. Suprotno: get divorced.

questions.q: Popuni: 'It was ___ cold to go out.' (negativno značenje)
questions.explain: too + adj = previše, uvek negativno: too cold = previše hladno.

questions.q: Razlika: 'It was very interesting' i 'It was really interesting'?
questions.explain: very i really su skoro istoznačni; oba pojačavaju (jako/stvarno).

questions.q: Reagovanje na priču: 'I went to Paris last week.' — najprirodnije:
questions.explain: Sounds great! / Really? / That's interesting. — pokazuju zainteresovanost.
Past Simple Wh- pitanje: Wh- + did + subjekat + bazni glagol.
Past Simple negacija: didn't + bazni glagol (bez -ed).

questions.q: Past Simple pitanje: '___ you find the file?'
questions.explain: Did + subjekat + bazni glagol. Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.
search engine = pretraživač (Google, Bing, …).
can + bazni glagol = sadašnja sposobnost.

questions.q: Popuni: 'When I was 5, I ___ read.' (sposobnost u prošlosti)
questions.explain: could = sposobnost u prošlosti.
buy → bought (nepravilan).
lose → lost (nepravilan).

questions.q: Popuni: 'I saw a film. ___ film was great.'
questions.explain: Drugi pomen već poznatog → the film.

options: I go to the school every day.
I go to school every day.
I go to a school every day.
I go to schools every day.
questions.explain: Ustaljeni izraz bez člana: go to school, go to bed, have lunch.

questions.q: Reaguj na vest: 'Twenty people are in hospital after a crash.'
questions.explain: That's terrible! / How awful! — empatija na lošu vest.

questions.q: Popuni: '___ a park near my house.'
questions.explain: There is + jednina (a park).
Pitanje: Are there any + množina?
many + brojivo (chairs). much + nebrojivo.
much + nebrojivo (milk).
any u negaciji i pitanju.
chemist's = apoteka. baker's = pekara, butcher's = mesara.

questions.q: Prodavac kaže: 'Can I help you?' — pristojan odgovor ako samo razgledaš:
questions.explain: I'm just looking, thanks. — vrlo uobičajen odgovor u prodavnici.
jeans = farmerke (uvek u množini, kažemo a pair of jeans).
a pair of + uvek-pluralne imenice (jeans, trousers, glasses, scissors).

questions.q: Popuni: 'I ___ buy a new pair of trainers.'
questions.explain: want + to + bazni glagol.

questions.q: Popuni: 'I ___ a report at the moment.'
questions.explain: Present Continuous za radnju koja se dešava sada: be + verb-ing.
CVC dupliranje suglasnika: sit → sitting; run → running.
Glagoli na -e gube e: write → writing; make → making.

questions.q: Razlikuj: 'I usually drive, but today I ___ the bus.'
questions.explain: today = ovaj specifičan dan → Present Continuous.

questions.q: Glagol koji NE ide u Present Continuous obliku je …
questions.explain: Stative verbs (know, like, want, need) ne idu u Continuous.
go on foot = ići peške; go by car/bus/plane.

questions.q: Popuni: 'Hello, ___ I speak to John, please?'
questions.explain: Could I speak to … ? — pristojna telefonska fraza.
Can I take a message? = Da li da prenesem poruku?
Pridev + ly → prilog: careful → carefully.
good (pridev) → well (prilog). She speaks English well.
go sightseeing = razgledati turističke znamenitosti.
Infinitive of purpose: to + bazni glagol (zbog čega).
for + imenica (for a holiday). to + glagol (to relax).
CVC dupliranje: big → bigger.
y → ier: happy → happier.
Duži pridevi: more + adj.
good → better; bad → worse (nepravilni).
How about + verb-ing? — predlog za aktivnost.

questions.q: Razlika: 'I like swimming.' i 'I'd like to swim.'
options: Prvo = uopšte volim, drugo = sad bih plivao/-la.
Prvo = jednom u životu, drugo = svaki dan.
questions.explain: like + ing = uopšte. would like + to + glagol = sada/jednom.
enjoy + verb-ing: I enjoy travelling.

questions.q: Imperativ za 'Ne pušiti!' na engleskom je:
questions.explain: Imperativ negacije: Don't + bazni glagol.
should + bazni glagol = blag savet.
shouldn't + bazni glagol = ne bi trebalo.
What's he like? = Kakav je (po karakteru).
What does he look like? = Kako izgleda.

questions.q: 'She's got long, dark hair.' — koji se glagol koristi za izgled?
questions.explain: have got za izgled (boje očiju, kosa, brada). be za visinu/karakter.
headache = glavobolja. stomach ache = bol u stomaku.

questions.q: Empatija na bolest: prijatelj kaže 'I've got a cold.' Ti kažeš:
options: I hope you get better soon.
questions.explain: Get well soon! / I hope you get better soon. — empatija.
Imenica + y → pridev: sun → sunny; cloud → cloudy; wind → windy.
Trenutno vreme: Present Continuous → it is raining.

questions.q: Popuni: 'I ___ get fit this year.' (siguran plan)
questions.explain: be + going to + bazni glagol. I'm going to get fit.
they → are. They are going to travel.

questions.q: Razlika: 'I'm going to study.' vs 'I might study.'
questions.explain: going to = siguran plan. might = neizvesno (možda da, možda ne).
might + bazni glagol (bez to).
pass an exam = položiti. fail an exam = pasti.
left = levo, right = desno, straight on = pravo.
opposite = preko puta. next to = pored. behind = iza.
Lots of love / Best wishes — neformalno. Yours faithfully — formalno.

questions.q: Popuni: 'Can I stay ___ you when I arrive?'
questions.explain: stay with someone = biti kod nekoga (gost).

questions.q: Pitanje: '___ you going to study tonight?'
questions.explain: be going to pitanje: Are/Is + subjekat + going to + glagol.
Kratak pridev + dupliranje + -est: big → the biggest.
Duži pridevi: the most + adj.
good → the best (nepravilno).
Decimalna tačka u engleskom = point. 1.5 = one point five.
go → went (Past Simple) → gone/been (PP).
see → saw → seen.
Iskustvo do sada (bez vremena) → Present Perfect: I've been to Italy.
she → has + past participle: She has never tried.

questions.q: Pitanje: '___ you ever been to London?'
questions.explain: Have/Has + subjekat + ever + past participle?

questions.q: Pristojan pozdrav pre puta: 'Have a ___ trip!'
questions.explain: Have a safe trip! = Srećan put! (sa željom za bezbednost).
